method: Planned: three fresh-profile attempts per data size and source format in the 925fc3c repeat. Earlier series have their own requested counts. Actual attempts are reported per cell. Normal combined quantiles require at least three profiles with all matched positions; every failed or incomplete attempt remains an outcome; first, middle and last record email values; twenty trusted CDP keydown/up pairs at requested 100 ms intervals. Per-key rAF uses trusted event timestamps. Event Timing records only events at/above its 16 ms threshold and is reported separately. Output update starts at the final trusted keydown timestamp for every editor, independent of native input events. Manual button times are separate. Percentiles use nearest rank.
